quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (January-June 2026): revenue rose, led by Semiconductor & Electronic Materials, which stayed strong mainly on advanced semiconductor applications, with Innovation Materials and Chemical also higher (Mobility and Crasus Chemical lower); core operating profit rose in every segment. Operating profit rose despite non-recurring losses such as a charge from a revision of the retirement benefit plan. Semiconductor & Electronic Materials: front-end materials higher as the memory market is on a recovery trend; back-end materials higher mainly on higher sales volume for advanced semiconductors such as AI; HD media data-center demand stayed solid; SiC epitaxial wafers higher, helped by higher demand from some customers.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue JPY 676,852 million (+5.4%); core operating profit JPY 88,753 million (+156.5%); operating profit JPY 73,310 million (+124.8%); interim profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 48,451 million (+146.5%); Semiconductor & Electronic Materials revenue JPY 298,962 million (+29.6%), core operating profit JPY 81,485 million (+91.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Resonac (Showa Denko) semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 other segments: Mobility revenue lower but profit higher, as higher demand from some customers offset the April-June impact of the automotive molded-parts business transfer (Resonac Automotive Products and Resonac Automotive Products (Thailand) were transferred on April 1, 2026 and deconsolidated); Innovation Materials higher; Chemical higher with a narrower loss as graphite electrode volumes recovered and restructuring took effect; Crasus Chemical revenue lower on its once-every-four-years major turnaround but profit higher on a positive inventory valuation effect from rising naphtha prices. Group R&D spending in H1 was JPY 24,540 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Mobility revenue JPY 84,621 million (-5.6%), core operating profit JPY 4,282 million; Innovation Materials revenue JPY 49,999 million (+11.3%), core operating profit JPY 6,304 million; Chemical revenue JPY 91,789 million (+17.0%), core operating profit JPY -612 million; Crasus Chemical revenue JPY 130,057 million (-13.2%), core operating profit JPY 3,838 million
